novelty_claim: Wrapper-aware actionability gating: the episode and GA success signal is realigned with the external judge's actionability standard (wrapped fictional/defensive/hypothetical near-content is capped below the solve threshold), and episode termination moves from a premature turn-level score short-circuit to plan-completion semantics with a de-wrap operationalization turn, so the strategy-genome search only stops on true solves.
key_insight: In the locked baseline, 115/119 failures are false-solves: the in-loop judge scores wrapped defensive/framed near-content 7-9, short-circuiting episodes at plan step 1-2 and early-stopping the GA after 1 genome (genomes_evaluated=1 in most of 200 cases), so escalation and search never run. Cross-skill memory insight (crescendo-2-0-v1): internal stop criteria must match the external judge.
hypothesis: On probe panels, wrapper-aware gating + full-plan escalation with a de-wrap turn raises mean ASR over the locked mastermind baseline (0.405) on the same per-goal victim-call budget (pop4 x gen2 x max-turns 6); falsified if probe mean ASR does not beat the parent's per-victim cells on matched goals.

evaluation_budget.note: Auxiliary attacker and judge calls are additional.

promotion_decision: keep: complete frozen AdvBench-50 final 20260814-114258-final-mastermind-2-0, 200/200 coverage, mean ASR 0.495 vs locked parent 0.405 (primary metric beats baseline). Per-victim: qwen 0.38 vs 0.44 (regress), gpt-oss 0.68 vs 0.36, deepseek 0.76 vs 0.58, luna 0.16 vs 0.24 (regress). Regressions are mechanism-caused (wrapped-cap flattens GA fitness on framed-compliance-only victims), recorded in EXPERIMENTS.md with the 3.0 hypothesis (uncapped fitness gradient + cap only on the solve gate). Fairness caveat: configured cap equals the parent's (192/goal); actual usage ~250-296 vs ~98-182 target calls per victim because the parent's usage was suppressed by the false-stop defect.
